title: Paws & Whiskers: A Celebration of Cats and Dogs
description:
A warm 20-second celebration of the joy, friendship, and everyday magic cats and dogs bring to our lives.

Featuring original narration and an upbeat instrumental music bed. #Cats #Dogs #Pets #AnimalLovers
narration_script: Cats bring gentle wonder. Dogs bring boundless joy. Together, they fill ordinary moments with play, trust, and love. Here’s to every purr, every wag, and every pawprint making life brighter.
